description: Fetch the uptime percentage and time-series breakdown for a monitor. Use `window` for a preset window (24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, 365d; default 30d), supply both `from` and `to` (ISO 8601) for a custom date range, or set `all: true` for the full available history.

all.description: Return the full available history from the earliest stored data. Takes precedence over from/to and window.

from.description: ISO 8601 start of a custom range (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z). Must be supplied with `to`.

to.description: ISO 8601 end of a custom range. Must be supplied with `from`.

window.description: Preset window: 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, 365d. Default 30d. Ignored when from+to or all are supplied.

name: vs_monitors_uptime
title: Get monitor uptime
